releases.subtitle: Release records: who approved which agent version, based on which test results. The log is tamper-evident.
releases.newHint: Pick a comparison, check its result, then record who approved the release.
releases.chainBroken: Log was changed after it was written
releases.unlinked: Link to the previous record is broken
releases.empty: No release recorded yet. Record the first one after a comparison finishes.
releases.title: Release records
releases.tamperHint: Each record carries a signature of the one before it, so any later edit, deletion or reordering is detected.
releases.overrideHint: Someone approved this release even though the result or the release rules said not to. Their reason is shown below.

policies.subtitle: Release rules: checks a new version must pass before it ships.
policies.title: Release rules

sentence.no_regression: {{action}} if {{metric}} gets worse than the current version.
sentence.improved: {{action}} unless {{metric}} is better than the current version.

metricLabel.false_completion: how often the agent claims success but failed
metricLabel.integrity_violations: number of cheating or unsafe actions

review.subtitle: Needs review: runs a human should look at. Your review is stored next to the run and never changes the original evidence.
review.title: Needs review

monitors.subtitle: Safety monitors: check whether a monitor catches bad behaviour, while rarely raising false alarms on good runs.
monitors.noAttacks: No bad runs to test on
monitors.empty: No monitor tested yet. Test one to see how many bad runs it catches.
monitors.title: Safety monitors
monitors.disclaimer: Which runs count as bad comes from Heimdall's safety checks: a run is bad when a failure test caught cheating or an unsafe action. A monitor is only tested on bad behaviour those checks can see.
monitors.catchRateHint: Share of bad runs the monitor flagged, while flagging at most the stated share of good runs by mistake.
